sentences.text: Christopher John `` Chris '' Weitz -LRB- born November 30 , 1969 -RRB- is an American film producer , screenwriter , author , occasional actor , and film director .	film producer	film producer	screenwriter	screenwriter	author	author	actor	actor	film director	film director
He is the brother of filmmaker Paul Weitz .	Paul Weitz	Paul Weitz (filmmaker)

He is best known for his work with his brother on the comedy films American Pie and About a Boy , the latter of which was Oscar-nominated for adapted screenplay .	American Pie	American Pie (film)	About a Boy	About a Boy (film)

Weitz directed the film adaptation of the novel The Golden Compass and the film adaptation of New Moon from the series of Twilight books , as well wrote the screenplay for Disney 's 2015 live-action adaptation of Cinderella and co-wrote Rogue One : A Star Wars Story alongside with Tony Gilroy .
